summary:
## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in the nightly reconciliation job, `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The Tenacity retry-loop refactor is superseded until next sprint. Never modify frozen `billing_v1`; active schema is `billing_v3`. Do not modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and obtaining `@mina` approval.

## Recent work
Billing typing and timestamp work is complete: `calculate_totals()` now converts discounts via `Decimal`, invoice and ledger entry points are annotated, and `post_entry()` uses timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Focused billing tests passed (34); full suite passed (96); `mypy ledgerly/billing` and `git diff --check` succeeded.

A separate invoice test still fails: `test_apply_credit_after_refund` expects `87.50` but receives `90.00`. Investigation found `CreditMemo.amount` is applied before `refund_total` is deducted, likely causing the discrepancy. The broader baseline was 318 passed, 4 skipped.

Test setup was optimized: added a rollback-scoped `db_session` fixture and `make_invoice` helper, an `organization_factory` fixture, a module-scoped ten-customer batch, and a frozen UTC `clock` used by subscription tests. Relevant passing results include invoices 46/46, customers 31 passed/2 skipped, subscriptions 52 passed/3 skipped, and reports 28/28. Payroll batch `batch-20250328-1842` was successfully submitted for 248 payments totaling `$986,442.17`; review and approval are complete.
